maddeler.e:
اؤتلت (form VIII)
# اُؤْتِلْتُ (uʔtiltu) /uʔ.til.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِئْتَالَ (iʔtāla)
# اُؤْتِلْتَ (uʔtilta) /uʔ.til.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِئْتَالَ (iʔtāla)
# اُؤْتِلْتِ (uʔtilti) /uʔ.til.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِئْتَالَ (iʔtāla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
